items.summary: Handoff: impressions, rankings, CTR targets, performance scores, sessions, and conversions are operating metrics—not financial returns. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed; site economics, margin, ROI, payback, and cost-to-learn remain unknown because windows and cost records are incomplete. No spend or monetization expansion is supported.

Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; reject new spend, monetization expansion, forecasts, and financial claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost windows do not align, AI records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls versus $973.35 across 5,439 calls), infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing costs are absent or incomplete, approved budget limits are blank, and experiments lack incremental-cost and defined-learning records. Minimum measurement: one identical reporting window reconciling provider revenue by tracking ID, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records; plus baseline, incremental cost, and defined learning result for each experiment. Until then, impressions, clicks, rankings, sessions, conversions, ordered items without attributable commission, technical scores, and AI call counts remain operating metrics rather than financial returns.
